prompt_inputs.content: Machine learning models require careful evaluation across multiple dimensions. The F1 score balances precision and recall, particularly useful when you need to optimize for both metrics equally. ROC-AUC evaluates classifier performance across all classification thresholds, providing a comprehensive view of trade-offs between true positive and false positive rates.
